OKAY! So I have tried this! And it yielded new information!
I copied the event and pasted it into the MapID1.
The one with the planter is the one that I pasted, the one that's blank is the 'copied' event.
While I was at it, also updated the code so that it would show when I clicked which page it was displaying.
And when I playtested it and opened the pasted event, it played the second page, which implies to me that there's something wrong with the way the SelfVariable Respawn Days is set up.
When I pasted this event into this page, the flower basin picture changed to a red line, and I figured out WHY. It's differences in the Tilesets! So that explains the red line! And why I thought it wasn't working! Because it WAS working, but it was displaying something other than I thought it would! WHICH MEANS, Now I just have to figure out why the SelfVariable Respawn Days isn't working and then I'll have harvestable bushes! WOO!
